name: ledger
description: Balances, transfers and signing with a Ledger device.

interface.shortDescription: Balances, transfers and signing with a Ledger device.
interface.longDescription: Read accounts and balances from a connected Ledger, and prepare transfers the device itself approves. Every signature happens on the device, against the recipient and amount shown on its screen — this plugin never holds a key and never asks for a recovery phrase.
defaultPrompt: Show my Ledger accounts and balances
Is my Ledger connected and unlocked?

network.title: Network
network.description: Which cluster to read. Mainnet and devnet balances look identical on screen and are not the same money.

keyPath.title: Default key path
keyPath.description: Derivation path to read first, for example 0/0. Leave empty to scan the device instead of assuming one.
